nodes.description: mapping(address=>mapping(uint256=>uint256)) rewards: accrued SM token rewards per user per collection
mapping(address=>mapping(uint256=>uint256)) lastUpdate: last reward-settlement timestamp per user per collection
mapping(uint256=>CollectionInfo) collectionInfo: name, boostCap and hardCap per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) totalSupplyByCollection: total rewards minted per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) remainingBoostByCollection: residual boost budget per collection
mapping(uint256=>uint256) remainingSupplyByCollection: residual mintable supply per collection
ISpaceCows spaceCows: external NFT contract used as minting-rate oracle and privileged caller
initialize(string,string): one-time upgradeable initializer, mints 6,182,917.50 SM to msg.sender
updateUserTimeOnMint(address,uint256): external, guarded by isAllowAddress, refreshes lastUpdate using block.timestamp
updateUserTime(address,uint256): internal helper writing block.timestamp into lastUpdate
calculateRewards(uint256,uint256): internal view computing final minting reward and removed boost from remaining caps
setRewards(address,uint256): internal settlement that calls spaceCows.getMintingRate then mutates rewards, lastUpdate and remaining cap mappings
updateReward(address,address,uint256): external, isAllowAddress, settles rewards for from and to
getReward(address,uint256): external, isAllowAddress, zeroes accrued reward and mints it to the user
burn(address,uint256,uint256): external, isAllowAddress, burns user tokens for a collection
getTotalClaimable(address,uint256): external view computing pending rewards from timestamp delta and spaceCows minting rate
setSpaceCowsAddress(address): external onlyOwner, sets the privileged ISpaceCows contract
setCollectionInfo(uint256,string,uint256,uint256): external onlyOwner, configures collection caps and remaining budgets
_authorizeUpgrade(address): internal onlyOwner UUPS upgrade authorization hook
msg.sender: caller identity used for isAllowAddress and onlyOwner authorization checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used for reward accrual and settlement
external call spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) executed inside setRewards before state updates
external call spaceCows.getMintingRate(_user) executed inside the view getTotalClaimable
arithmetic in setRewards: mintingRate.mul(time.sub(userTimer)).div(86400) and unguarded decrements of remainingSupplyByCollection/remainingBoostByCollection
